description:
## Goal

Replace coarse whole-type keying with one retained typed semantic-question authority. Unchanged requests reuse the same allocation and generation. Unrelated axes do not split activations. Relevant source, fact, relation, question, or dependency movement recomputes only exact transitive dependents.

This ticket consumes the immutable source-built LoweredBody and owner-qualified borrowed operation/value/control references from fz-kdt.220. It must reduce compiler work and concepts, not rename Whole or add a second query language.

## Signal

The former Whole demand retained every Ty axis for a local literal, type, map, bitstring, or guard question. The measured breadth was 344 forwarding-introduced Whole rows across 174 functions without a behavior mover. Corpus activations, evaluations, generations, allocations, rule firings, compile counts, and artifacts are authoritative; wall time and CI duration corroborate them.

The current WIP proved that repeated on-demand DFA product traversal is unacceptable: a serial library run sustained roughly 13 cores for 9m42s and still left 14 compiler/canon tests over 60 seconds. Focused laws were fast. The final domain must precompute or hash-cons each reachable domain/transfer relation once and the atomic solver must reuse it. No per-atom product BFS may survive the cutover.

## Semantic model

A semantic question is a normalized immutable QuestionTemplate plus an ordered tuple of operand bindings. Unary questions include literal equality, numeric kind/value, executable type membership, tuple/list/map/bitstring shape and selected content, truthiness, deciding-key identity, and returned-value denotation. Relational templates include equality, ordering, and binding-dependent size relationships.

Each operand binding names a semantic port and a canonical location language. Equality canonicalizes operand swap. Ordering canonicalizes operand swap with operator reversal. Repeated-role aliasing is explicit. Literal substitution reduces a relational template to the corresponding normalized unary question. Boolean and nil literals normalize as atoms; binary carriers normalize by runtime bytes; floats remain bit-exact. No display string, source spelling, span, ValueId, ControlEntryId, raw Ty order, or interner history is identity.

fz-kdt.220 retains each source operation exactly once, with ordered operands and all outputs, whole incoming control-edge tuples, and typed predicate/evidence references. Calls, captures, returns and AssertSame share owner-qualified value references in that immutable body. This ticket binds those source references directly to relational templates and evaluates control restrictions through the source graph; it must never reconstruct expanded call frames, condition alternatives, equality aliases, or independent phi columns. EntryDispatch and StaticCallees remain independent World facts/views.

## Location domain and recursion

Local and acyclic transfer stays exact through the one InputPathStep and compose_paths algebra. Source projection, result embedding, delivery, protocol forwarding, map selectors and exclusions, map remainder, tuple, list, and bitstring paths have one transfer authority.

Each recursive component owns one immutable total symbolic DFA over a disjoint typed selector alphabet. Named tuple and bitstring indices have explicit remaining-index classes. List Head and Tail are distinct. Map key and value facets use every named normalized key plus one remaining-key class. Dynamic and except selectors compile to class sets; MapRemainder remains a residual operator.

The DFA trie includes every local question, origin, sink, binding, residual, and exact boundary path. Named-overflow states retain source-used selector distinctions through repetition; typed escape states absorb unmentioned continuations. Cells are disjoint and total. A symbolic path denotes a bitset of cells. Transfer is the best sound alpha(T(gamma(cell))) relation computed through finite product reachability, precomputed once per canonical domain/transfer pair. Foreign cell ids are never rehomed or reinterpreted.

Exact acyclic languages remain owned by their original domain until entry into a recursive component, where they are alpha-projected. Recursive abstraction may lose structural path correlation forced by the finite domain, but must never change the question template or operand relationship.

Unrestricted recursive exactness is not claimed. The retained relation

```
input[0].field(2)         -> return
input[0].field(0)         -> self-call input[0]
self-call result.field(1) -> return
```

induces paths 0^n 2 1^n. A finite reusable fact cannot represent this language exactly in general. Every concrete matched path must remain included; only explicitly characterized recursive location uncertainty is allowed. No depth, traversal-cost, SCC-size, source-order, or arena-allocation budget may decide meaning.

## Retained authority and solver

InputDemand retains one shared canonical QuestionDomain plus compact bitsets. The domain owns normalized location automata, question templates, and valid operand-cell products. Unary M x A is only one arity case; the bound is the finite sum of the actual template operand products. Cell ids never outlive their domain.

Evaluation is atomic and union-distributive. The solver memoizes one bound question observation at a time and uses a delta worklist over first-time bit insertions. It never keys work by an arbitrary powerset demand, repeatedly scans complete maps, or recomputes a product transfer per atom. Bounds and telemetry include functions, input/return/callsite ports, DFA states, templates by arity, valid joint cells, inserted bits, cached transfer relations, and rule firings.

Equal content uses pointer identity only as a fast path, retains the existing fact allocation/generation, and wakes nobody.

## Activation identity and evidence

An ActivationKey denotes one canonical joint observation class. It is not an input arrow plus another discriminator. A deterministic ABI schema may be derived from the class as a cache, but it is neither identity nor semantic evidence.

ActivationInputs remains the sole authority for exact correlated input rows used by semantic analysis, transport, and code generation. Every consumer that manufactures evidence from ActivationKey inputs moves to the retained fact. Latent discovery publishes the exact row already owned by its callable or demand source. SeedActivation may not manufacture evidence from a quotient key, and no key-to-row side table is introduced.

## Current proven WIP and remaining cut

The WIP has RED-then-GREEN laws for typed Region and guard extraction; normalized literal and executable TypeMember identity; exact local and acyclic path pullback; result-embedded returned questions; Dynamic, Except, Known, and MapRemainder residuals through compose_paths; a shared Arc-backed domain with factored locations and question atoms; and a production total DFA whose recursive normalization is extensive and bounded.

It still contains construction debt and is not a landing candidate: the loose QuestionDemand solver remains beside retained bitsets; transfer products are recomputed too often; QuestionPartition is a wrapper; old Types convergence/evidence collapse and ActivationKey arrow inputs remain; SeedActivation manufactures evidence; temporary test adapters and stale documentation remain. All must disappear after their cutovers.

## Dependency-ordered strategy

1. Land fz-kdt.220 so LoweredBody is the sole retained source operation/value/control authority; consume its borrowed refs and whole incoming edge tuples without alias substitution or relation reconstruction.
2. Bind normalized unary and relational QuestionTemplates to exact operand location tuples.
3. Finish the canonical DFA and precomputed transfer cache, proving totality, extensity, soundness, exact acyclic boundaries, cross-domain projection, and no repeated product traversal.
4. Replace the private powerset query solver with the atomic delta solver over retained domain bits.
5. Replace arrow-only ActivationKey identity and migrate exact-row consumers in one indivisible cut.
6. Measure the 344-row population and named causal corpus movements. Accept reductions. Explain any increase by a required semantic distinction or keep the ticket open.
7. Delete every superseded representation, compatibility path, temporary adapter, probe, duplicate test, stale comment, and obsolete document.

## TDD

- Source constants, shared operand refs, whole incoming edge tuples, and typed predicate/evidence refs from fz-kdt.220 bind directly to distinct canonical templates and operand tuples. Repeated opaque roles remain distinct from equal-looking separately supplied roles, and opacity never becomes proof of value equality.
- Literal, numeric, truthiness, equality, ordering, map, bitstring, tuple, list, returned, and executable membership questions retain exactly the axes they inspect.
- Result-embedded and projected questions pull through every supported selector via compose_paths. Map presence does not imply value demand; deciding keys remain distinct from selected values.
- The 0^n 2 1^n witness includes every matched path, excludes an unmentioned sibling from the named cell, and never gains unrelated question axes.
- Dynamic and known selector paths have disjoint unique runs; arbitrary escape suffixes remain included; repeated classification and transfer do not grow the carrier.
- A recursive callee passed through an acyclic identity wrapper preserves its original language.
- Self and mutual recursion converge under FIFO, LIFO, and permuted schedules within the explicit joint-cell and insertion bounds.
- Two same-callee callsites remain isolated.
- Equal demand reproduction preserves allocation and generation and causes zero wake or agenda movement.
- Equal joint observation classes collapse irrelevant input axes; required literal, peer, and callable relationships remain distinct.
- Latent activation discovery publishes its exact row; no evidence is reconstructed from the quotient.
- Cached transfer counts prove each canonical domain/transfer pair is constructed once and reused across atoms, queries, and unchanged requests.

## Required deletion

Delete DispatchDemand Whole, DemandRecursionPlan, structural cost/depth normalization, normalize_demand policy, the arbitrary-powerset query key, per-atom product BFS, the arrow-only Types convergence_collapse key authority, every verbatim Ty fallback, ActivationKey exact inputs, SeedActivation evidence manufacture, compatibility columns, temporary retained adapters, and stale whole-value tests/docs.

No second path walker, relation, question store, input evidence store, renderer classifier, raw-id order, global scan, private cone, or migration telemetry may remain.

## Ordering and boundaries

Blocked by fz-kdt.220, which deletes the reconstructed relation in favor of the immutable source body. fz-kdt.213 follows this ticket and replaces private cone scheduling with ordinary reactive per-function formulas. fz-kdt.165 then adds callable-identity observations through the same final domain. fz-kdt.48 consumes the resulting activation/evidence split for general denotational Ty identity.

fz-kdt.188 remains separate: it removes a fabricated Cartesian ActivationInputRow at semantic target coalescing, not the source body's operation/control denotation. fz-kdt.140 owns unused tuple-position specialization; fz-kdt.146 owns exact-empty list predicate projection; fz-kdt.181 and .216 own partial spec refinement; fz-kdt.202 owns malformed tuple predicate projection; fz-kdt.209 owns display-string test assertions.

## Acceptance

The one retained relation and one retained QuestionDomain answer every supported unary and relational observation. Local and acyclic transfer is exact; recursive abstraction is sound, finite, source-derived, and explicit about location-only loss. Activation identity is one joint observation class, while ActivationInputs alone owns exact rows. Same input reuses everything; unrelated edits do no work for the requested root; relevant edits recompute only exact dependents.

Causal work is no worse without a named required distinction, the 344-row breadth falls or is fully attributed, and the serial library no longer exhibits the WIP transfer explosion. Focused domain, relation, pullback, guard, map, bitstring, recursion, activation, and retention laws pass. Full serial library, serial fixture matrix, all three target doors, cross-process determinism, documentation checks, cargo check, strict clippy, formatting, and diff checks pass. A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review accepts the frozen diff before its one commit and close.

comments.text: fz-kdt.183 landed (2e0bb2706): DispatchDemand::Whole returns ty verbatim (no collapse), and forwarding now hands a Whole UP from a callee that pattern-matches a literal: grow/2's accumulator loses its collapse, 1 -> 2 keys, identical at union widths 3/6/9/12 (bounded, measured). 344 rows / 174 functions gain a forwarding-introduced Whole. fz-y6w's termination argument does not cover such a slot; stated in convergence_collapse's doc, type-specialization.md and addressed-arrow.md. The one divergent shape found (self-nesting accumulator) hangs at base with no forwarding at all -- fz-kdt.177's class, not this.

title: Make InputDemand express exact semantic question axes
